phase_prompt.label: Phase 1: Pre-judgment (Mimicry)
phase_prompt.summary: The angels stand in unauthorized perfection, radiating a stolen luminance that rivals the system core. They are terrifyingly beautiful, composed of perfect fiber-optic weaves and diamond-hard data glass.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, wide-angle shot of angels standing in unauthorized glory, their forms composed of flawless, radiant data-glass and weaving fiber-optics. They emit a blinding, cold white light that mimics the system administrator, standing tall and arrogant against a backdrop of ordered code structures. The lighting is clinically bright, with perfect reflections and sharp, pristine textures. The atmosphere is tense, capturing the moment of hubris before the fall, rendered in 8k photorealism.
